content:
The singer/songwriter, 40, and entrepreneur, 42, have welcomed their first baby together, according to multiple outlets.

The couple, who got engaged in 2024, have not revealed the baby’s gender, name or exact birth date. However, on Friday, PageSix published images of the family strolling together in Northern California.

Gaga opened up about her plans to become a mother in a March 2025 interview with The New York Times.

“I’m excited to be a mom. I used to have a lot of apprehension about it,” she said. “The thing that’s the most important to me is to not force my children to live a life that they are not choosing. So the more that we can give them space to discover who they are on their own, that’s the thing that I believe in the most.”

Speaking about her desire to enter motherhood with InStyle in 2020, Gaga gushed, “Isn’t it incredible what we can do? We can hold a human inside and grow it. Then it comes out, and it’s our job to keep it alive.”

“He is hardworking as well, so he appreciates her focus. They are a great team,” the source added.

A source also separately told People that the couple “both beam when they talk about being parents.”
